specificFindings: Replicated using other measures means the reported pattern was also supported with measures such as the essentialism scale. It does not assert randomised childhood reading or necessarily a new independent participant sample.

Empirical support for Trillings thesis is read with the explicit correlational-study caveat in the same parent. The1950 book quotation is philosophical interpretation and causality still needs future testing.

Repeatedly argued contrasts with so far not provided empirical evidence. This is a time-bounded concession before the visual experiments,not a claim there can never be evidence or that later results have already failed.

Noma Bars Figure2 and the actual image were visually inspected on page98. The authored questions rely on the existing English description rather than requiring the site to reproduce an illustration not included in the passage.

Skinny tall beer glass is the initial described object. Face-like foam is a conditional perception under a certain view,not replacement with a real face or a claim every observer must see both simultaneously.

The original-image procedure is show on screen,ask what is seen,write answer,then another page asks what else. No prior disclosure of all interpretations or unrelated reading-history task is inserted.
Beer or face depends on perspective within the same image. Most and many preserve different observer frequencies,not an all-person simultaneous-view guarantee.

The altered group image retains essentially the same glass with the eye bubble removed. Figure3 on page99 was visually inspected; questions do not reverse removal into adding a face or changing every feature.

Just a glass explains absent secondary-face perception. It is still an image,not an actual drink supplied to participants. Same two questions retains prompts but is not expanded to every unspecified experimental condition being identical.
Else seeks an additional observation,not an instruction to erase a first answer or a promise of a particular face response. The second question continues across adjacent original units.

First group drawings are presented one at a time with written descriptions. Second group receives slightly altered drawings lacking the secondary object and also describes what is seen; no poem,price or pre-shown answer task is invented.
Subtle visual versus huge psychological difference contrasts degree of stimulus change with reported richness difference,not an unstated numerical effect size or physically changed eyes.
Multiple things in one drawing concerns interpretations within an image,not multiple images physically superimposed. It does not imply every observer sees all interpretations at the same moment.

Perhaps initial puzzlement is a tentative account,not a measured universal sequence or response requirement. More certain secondary-view identification is the described endpoint,not proof of higher happiness.
Control drawings are singular,clear,unambiguous; the same parent explicitly says the groups were equally happy. Richer perception is not collapsed into improved mood.
For some pastime and for others more than entertainment retain different experiences of sports. The Kant quote is a conceptual framing,not a clinical finding that all sports lack value.
Unscripted outcomes supply the stated dramatic potential. The passage does not guarantee every match produces richness or replace all other aesthetic experiences.

The1986 missed-groundball account is treated as the books compressed historical illustration of reversal. No fresh verification of a complete play-by-play championship causal chain is claimed,and no current World Series result is reported.
Impossible passes and improbable dunks use appreciative sports rhetoric and distinct named players. They are not statements of physical impossibility or present-day team membership.

Houston Rockets1995 frames the upcoming personal anecdote;1993-1994 and Olajuwon describe their prior team-first NBA title,not the entire leagues first title. My favourite is author preference,not fabricated user history.

Offense struggled uses the basketball attacking-play sense,not crime or personal insult. The exact target sentence alone is evidence,leaving later unassigned record/seed material for future questions; no injury cause is invented.
